requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Make the entire introduction transition smooth and continuous.

prompt1BSection.exactText: 1. Launch / Intro - This is great! But add something in the code that ensures this is a smooth transition. Step by step by step. No lag. Also the entire transition should not be rushed. The complete Fruitfolio intro should last approximately 6–8 seconds, long enough for every stage to feel intentional without becoming slow: the closed blank book appears and settles, the watercolor logo gradually seeps onto it (with the ripple puddle effect), the branded book pauses briefly, the book opens slightly, then fully, and finally the view smoothly zooms into the right page before transitioning into the Hub. No stage should immediately snap into the next; each important visual should have a brief moment to register, with the logo reveal and book-opening sequence receiving the most time. Reduce Motion should preserve the same visual sequence with simplified transitions rather than simply rushing through it.

requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Make the reduced-motion introduction smooth without simply accelerating the sequence.

prompt1BSection.exactText: 1. Launch / Intro - This is great! But add something in the code that ensures this is a smooth transition. Step by step by step. No lag. Also the entire transition should not be rushed. The complete Fruitfolio intro should last approximately 6–8 seconds, long enough for every stage to feel intentional without becoming slow: the closed blank book appears and settles, the watercolor logo gradually seeps onto it (with the ripple puddle effect), the branded book pauses briefly, the book opens slightly, then fully, and finally the view smoothly zooms into the right page before transitioning into the Hub. No stage should immediately snap into the next; each important visual should have a brief moment to register, with the logo reveal and book-opening sequence receiving the most time. Reduce Motion should preserve the same visual sequence with simplified transitions rather than simply rushing through it.
